description: Summary: Enforce KMS region pinning at RBAC v2 policy evaluation time and fix audit logging gaps that previously omitted kms_key_id and effective_region for cross-region KMS attachments. Motivation: customers operating under regional data residency constraints need deterministic enforcement and complete audit trails that show which key and region protected a resource. This PR implements enforcement, improves audit events, provides a migration for existing bindings, and updates docs and tests. Changes: policy evaluator now checks policy.kms.residency and enforces that resource.kms.region == policy.kms.allowed_regions when mode == 'enforce'. Audit logger schema bumped: audit events now include kms_key_id, requested_region, effective_region, and policy_version for RBAC v2 decisions. Migration script added to mark legacy bindings with kms_residency: unspecified so teams can opt-in to strict enforcement. Integration tests and e2e cases added to the test harness; added a stubbed KMS resolver used by CI. Docs updated with upgrade and rollout guidance. Checklist: [x] Enforcement logic and unit tests; [x] Audit logging and schema changes; [x] DB migration script and migration tests; [x] Integration / e2e tests (fixed flake); [x] Docs and release notes; [ ] Rollout canary plan (follow-up Linear ENG-4321). Deployment notes: Default behavior remains backwards-compatible: until rollout is complete the platform will run in 'audit' mode for existing customers and will only enforce for new tenants or when tenant opt-in is performed via the console or API. For the initial canary we will enable enforce mode for a small percentage of traffic in dedicated EU region; monitoring dashboards added in Redwood Console (route: rbac.v2.kms.enforce). Related work: ENG-4321, SEC-211.
review_comments: Carlos Mendes: High level LGTM, but please add a unit test for the case where policy allows multiple regions and resource has 'global' key. Also note: we should avoid throwing 500s if kms resolver times out; prefer 429 or policy-defer.
Author (Nadia): Added edge-case test and updated evaluator to return policy_deferred error type; see commit d4e5f6a.
Priya Kapoor: Audit event shape looks good. Please add a short note in docs about retention/PII implications of including kms_key_id.
Author (Nadia): Added docs note and filed COM-98 for retention guidance.
